graph.name: 16. Consult the current campaign notebook
graph.description:
Learn to consult a notebook that can change between runs. Unlike the imported lore sheet in lesson 6, Read File fetches the current contents of a story document each time you use it.

What you'll learn:
• Read the current contents of an authorized file.
• Distinguish a current document from an imported copy.
• Known sample content initializes automatically; existing saved content stays authoritative.

Before you start:
• Open this lesson in a practice chat and enable Lattice before Send. The main reply uses your current SillyTavern connection.
• The sample campaign notebook prepares automatically for this copy. Its File section shows the name, automatic type and readiness. Use Choose file or Import from device for a personal notebook.
• Known practice files prepare automatically in this independent copy. Opening and previewing make no paid requests or output writes. Existing saved content always wins. For personal inputs, use the node File section to Choose file or Import from device; importing creates an independent input copy.

Steps:
1. Check that Read File points to campaign-notebook. Follow its text output through Compose to the guidance input of Generate Reply.
2. Send a message about the harbor and inspect the notebook text used for this run.
3. For a personal exercise, import a notebook copy where the lighthouse is lit using Read File → File → Import from device. Send again and compare the supplied text. Lesson 17 introduces Write to File for updating saved contents.
4. Compare this with File Input in lesson 6. That box keeps its imported copy until you replace it; Read File consults the current document.
5. Review the final reply and any proposed saved changes at Review / Publish. Choose Apply reviewed candidate to accept them, or Reject candidate to discard them. Preview alone does not save changes.

Checkpoints:
Read File · sample notebook → text: The current notebook text reaches the advice supplied before the reply is written.

Try this:
Edit the chosen notebook between runs.
The next live read sees the new content. If a captured file changes during a run, rerun before accepting; an imported copy remains independent of its original.

If something is different:
The document is missing or unavailable: Read File shows the problem so you can correct the target or its access.

Model requests: No extra model requests. SillyTavern writes one reply.
